Company Description Smart Parrot Language Institute, based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, provides language education in English, French, Arabic, and specialized programs such as IELTS preparation and business English for children and adults. The institute combines language learning with creative workshops, clubs, and interactive sessions that foster self-expression and imagination. Smart Parrot also hosts community events and networking opportunities that help learners practise languages, explore cultures, and build meaningful social connections. In addition, it offers personal and professional development activities focused on communication, confidence, and career growth. The institute actively collaborates with schools, businesses, and other organizations to expand educational and creative opportunities.

Role Description The Special Education Teacher will design and deliver instructional programs that support learners with diverse disabilities in language and personal development settings. This full-time, on-site role in Jeddah involves planning and adapting lessons to meet individual education needs, using differentiated instruction and appropriate accommodations. The teacher will collaborate with other educators and staff to integrate learners with special needs into classes, workshops, and community activities. Daily responsibilities include assessing learners’ strengths and challenges, developing individualized plans, tracking progress, and maintaining clear communication with families and caregivers. The role also requires contributing to a safe, inclusive, and culturally responsive learning environment aligned with Smart Parrot’s mission.
q: Solid understanding of disabilities and diverse learning needs, with the ability to adapt instruction and support learners effectively.
Strong teaching skills, including lesson planning, classroom management, and differentiated instruction in inclusive educational settings.
Experience or training in special education, including individualized education planning and use of appropriate interventions and supports.
Effective communication skills for working with learners, families, and multidisciplinary teams in a multicultural environment.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Special Education, Education, or a related field; relevant certifications in special education are an advantage.
Experience working with middle school–aged learners or similar age groups is preferred.
Ability to collaborate with colleagues, participate in professional development, and contribute to inclusive institutional practices.
Proficiency in English required; knowledge of Arabic or other languages is beneficial.
